name: Recursive Teaching Dimension of the Ben-David--Eiron Family
proof: Ben-David--Eiron give $\mathrm{VC}(\mathcal C_n^d)=d$. The explicit quadratic theorem of Hu--Wu--Li--Wang therefore bounds $\mathrm{RTD}(\mathcal C_n^d)$ by $39.3752d^2-3.6330d$, uniformly in $n$. Here $d$ is fixed and $n$ is the family variable.
